question: Which gas is utilised during the preparation of bleaching powder?
solution:
The correct answer is Chlorine

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chlorine **is utilised during the **preparation of bleaching powder.**
 
• Bleaching powder, also known as calcium hypochlorite, is produced by the reaction of calcium hydroxide with chlorine gas.
 
• The chemical equation for the preparation of bleaching powder is:
 
• Ca(OH)₂ + Cl₂ ---> Ca(OCl)²⁻
